# 74S112 - Dual J-K negative-edge-triggered flip-flop with preset and clear

Package DIP-16 · family 74S · catalogue file [catalog/chips/74S112.json](https://github.com/RetroCoreLabs/RetroSchematic/blob/master/src/catalog/chips/74S112.json)

## Functions

| Output pin | Formula | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| 5 | 1Q = FF1 | Flip-flop 1 output. |
| 6 | /1Q = NOT FF1 | Complement of flip-flop 1 (except both high while PRESET and CLEAR are both low). |
| 9 | 2Q = FF2 | Flip-flop 2 output. |
| 7 | /2Q = NOT FF2 | Complement of flip-flop 2 (except both high while PRESET and CLEAR are both low). |

## Stored state

Bits stored: 2

Changes on: falling edge of each flip-flop's CK

- PRESET low, CLEAR high: Q = 1, Q' = 0 at once
- PRESET high, CLEAR low: Q = 0, Q' = 1 at once
- PRESET low and CLEAR low: Q = 1 and Q' = 1 (not stable: does not persist when preset and clear return high)
- PRESET high, CLEAR high, falling CLOCK edge: J=L,K=L hold; J=H,K=L Q=1; J=L,K=H Q=0; J=H,K=H toggle
- CLOCK high (no falling edge): hold

## Electrical

| Value | Figure |
|---|---|
| outputLowMaxCurrentMa | 20 |
| outputHighMaxCurrentMa | -1 |
| inputSchmitt | no |
| notes | Clear and preset inputs: IIL -7 mA max (clear tested with preset high and preset with clear high), IIH 100 uA; J, K IIL -1.6 mA, IIH 50 uA; clock IIL -4 mA, IIH 100 uA. |

## Propagation delays

| From | To | Edge | Typ ns | Max ns | Conditions |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| PRESET or CLEAR | Q or Q' | PLH | 4 | 7 | VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, CL 15 pF, RL 280 ohm |
| PRESET or CLEAR | Q' or Q | PHL | 5 | 7 | clock high; VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, CL 15 pF, RL 280 ohm |
| PRESET or CLEAR | Q' or Q | PHL | 5 | 7 | clock low; VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, CL 15 pF, RL 280 ohm |
| CLOCK | Q or Q' | PLH | 4 | 7 | VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, CL 15 pF, RL 280 ohm |
| CLOCK | Q or Q' | PHL | 5 | 7 | VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, CL 15 pF, RL 280 ohm |
